If you have any questions or require assistance, please contact: Pavlinka Kovatcheva Faculty Librarian: Science (APK & DFC) 📞 011 559 2621 ✉️ pkovatcheva@uj.ac.za Kgothatso Mashobane APK Information Librarian: Science & FEBE 📞 011 559 2470 ✉️ kmashobane@uj.ac.za Library Open Hours Access to the UJ Libraries can only be granted if you have a valid UJ Card. For more information, visit the Library Hours Take Virtual 3D Tour of the APK Library Mapping: Floor & Subject allocation (Books) This link opens in a new window Maps to help you find the location of your books in the library Borrowing Books You will need your UJ student /staff card to borrow books. Borrowing & Returning Print books: you can check-out - 6 Print Books for 14 days Unlimited access to Online Books For more information on membership types and borrowing privileges, see Lending Services Q1: “Who may borrow and for how long?” Renewing Books All items from the general collection may be renewed twice if the item has not been placed on hold for/by another client). Please note: Items from the reserve collection CANNOT be renewed. Items may be renewed by phone (011 559 2165), online (access the Library Catalogue , click on “My UJLink” and follow the prompts) or in person at the Lending desk Lending Self Service You can perform the following services yourself without assistance from the Lending desk staff – Access your patron record (library record) – Place a hold on an item – Renew items currently checked out – Access class notes or articles placed on the reserved collection – Issue items to yourself (self-checkout) For detailed instructions, visit Lending self service. Missing Books If an item shows ‘available’ on the catalogue, but it is not on the shelves: Complete the online “Missing books” form The Library staff will search for the item and place it on hold for you if found. If not found, the item will be indicated as “Missing” on the catalogue To search for Print & Online Books , please use the Library Catalogue or the Science Subject LibGuides Prescribed Textbooks Search the Course Reserve to find the books prescribed for your course They can be used only in the Library for 2h; Please book your session HERE if you have a point of need chat Welcome GEOGRAPHY: GEO-INFORMATICS This portal supports the Geo-Informatics students. This LibGuide provides information on key resources for Geographic Information Systems including: Print books, eBooks and Journals Key databases to search for articles and other materials avoiding plagiarism and citing properly "In a GIS, you connect data with geography . And you understand what belongs where . Because you don’t fully understand your data until you see how it relates to other things in a geographic context. Geographic Information Systems is a computer-based tool that analyzes, stores, manipulates and visualizes geographic information, usually in a map."
